paragraphs.zh: 式中，溴代试剂为溴素、N-溴代丁二酰亚胺、或者溴化氢与双氧水的组合，优选为溴素；CF3CH2OM为CF3CH2ONa或CF3CH2OK。
paragraphs.en: In the formulae, the brominating agent is bromine, N-bromosuccinimide, or a combination of hydrogen bromide and hydrogen peroxide, preferably bromine; CF3CH2OM is CF3CH2ONa or CF3CH2OK.
paragraphs.notes: Subscripts are printed as true subscripts in CF3CH2OM / CF3CH2ONa / CF3CH2OK; transcribed here as plain digits. The hyphen in N-溴代丁二酰亚胺 is printed as a half-width hyphen.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明再一方面提供上述式(I)～式(IV)化合物作为环磺酮制备中间体的用途。
paragraphs.en: A further aspect of the present invention provides the use of the above compounds of formula (I) to formula (IV) as intermediates for the preparation of tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name of the herbicide tembotrione; translated as tembotrione.

paragraphs.zh: 实施例1 式(VI)化合物的制备
paragraphs.en: Example 1  Preparation of the compound of formula (VI)

paragraphs.zh: 在20℃下将5.1％盐酸1165g加入到四口瓶中，滴加3-氯-2-甲基苯胺100g，滴加完毕后，在0℃进一步滴加20％NaNO2水溶液251.41g，滴加过程中控温不超
paragraphs.en: At 20 degrees C, 1165 g of 5.1% hydrochloric acid was charged into a four-necked flask, and 100 g of 3-chloro-2-methylaniline was added dropwise.
